hero.title: Hello, I'm
hero.subtitle: I work primarily with Godot Engine, creating 2D and 3D games, gameplay systems, and low-poly assets. I aim to develop lightweight, well-optimized projects with a unique identity.

about.label: About
about.title: Who am i
about.p1: I am a Brazilian game developer, programmer, and 3D artist. I work on transforming ideas into playable experiences, ranging from prototypes to full projects.
about.p2: My main tool is Godot Engine, but I also use Crocotile3D and other technologies depending on project needs. I focus on performance, organization, and the development of reusable systems.

modeling.label: 3D Modeling
modeling.title: Crocotile 3D
modeling.description: I produce low-poly models using Crocotile3D, a tile-based tool that allows for the creation of lightweight, stylized game assets. The result is a consistent aesthetic with excellent performance.

games.label: Games
games.title: Things I've made
games.description: A selection of personal projects, game jams, and professional work developed throughout my career.

shatteredParadise.title: Shattered Paradise
shatteredParadise.subtitle: Godot JR Dev · One More Turn Studios
shatteredParadise.description: A dungeon-crawling roguelike spanning Inferno, Purgatory, and Paradise | built in Godot by One More Turn Studios. I am part of the development team, testing systems and implementing mechanics.

fightLifeLegacy.title: Fight Life Legacy
fightLifeLegacy.subtitle: Turn-based MMA RPG · Blade games
fightLifeLegacy.description: A turn-based fighting RPG about rising through the MMA ranks, training attributes, and following a story of legacy and mystery. I contributed during development.

crimsonYule.title: The Crimson Yule
crimsonYule.subtitle: Occultism Simulator
crimsonYule.description: This game is an occult-themed living-world simulator where the player follows neither a linear story nor a predefined objective. Instead, they take on the role of an outsider in a dynamic village, defining their own identity while interacting with an environment that operates independently.

andromeda.title: Take it to Andromeda
andromeda.subtitle: NES-style · 32 MB
andromeda.description: A Gorillaz fan game for the Lost Cartridge Jam.

tiny4.title: Tiny 4 Bullets
tiny4.subtitle: 4 players, online
tiny4.description: Play with 4 friends and get the train to its destination.

beakPulp.title: Beak and Pulp
beakPulp.subtitle: Adventure
beakPulp.description: An island hidden in the middle of the ocean. No outsider has ever set foot on this island, until now...

chip.title: Chip Keyboard
chip.subtitle: 38 MB
chip.description: A rhythm game where you press keys to stay alive.

rdk.title: Rapid Deployment Killzone
rdk.subtitle: Third-person action
rdk.description: Updated gameplay with seamless spaceship-to-planet transitions, Commander Amelia with improved animations, and more. A third-person shooter inspired by MDK and Tribes.

talora.title: Talora Roll Desk
talora.subtitle: In development
talora.description: Play your favorite RPG with friends on this open-source platform.

future1.title: Next project
future1.description: Empty slot — I'll drop something here when it's ready.

animation.label: Animation
animation.title: Animation portfolio
animation.description: Character intros, cutscenes, and motion work brought to life in Godot.

commanderAmelia.title: Commander Amelia
commanderAmelia.subtitle: Character intro
commanderAmelia.description: An animated character introduction built in Godot, showcasing personality, timing, and scene composition.

web.label: Web
web.title: Websites too
web.description: I also develop responsive web applications, prioritizing performance, accessibility, and streamlined interfaces.
web.experience: I worked at the Civil House of the State of Rio de Janeiro, developing institutional websites, graphic materials, and audiovisual content for government communication.

activities.web: Official websites | responsive, accessible, and truly functional.
activities.design: Layouts and visuals for institutional digital assets.
activities.video: Planned, filmed, and edited institutional videos.

contact.label: Contact
contact.title: Let's work together
contact.subtitle: I'm available for game development, programming, 3D modeling, and indie project collaborations.

gamesPage.description: Godot is my main engine. I use it for 2D and 3D | whether it's something cute, dark humor, or action-packed, whatever the game calls for. Here are my projects so far.

galleryPage.label: Media
galleryPage.description: Images, GIFs, and videos from my projects and experiments.

crocotilePage.description: I accept commissions for low-poly models—characters, props, simple environments. Great for games that need style without killing the frame rate.
crocotilePage.pricingText: One model: $6 USD · Pack of 5: $28 USD

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: Sketch the idea, pick a style, make a tilemap. References help a lot here.

modeling.title: Modeling
modeling.description: I set up the shapes and adjust the vertices until it looks right.

texturing.title: Texturing
texturing.description: I paint onto the mesh using a tilemap.

optimization.title: Optimization
optimization.description: I organize layers, check the mesh, and ensure the lighting is readable.

export.title: Export
export.description: I save as .obj or .gltf, including the tilemap if needed for other software.
